svg.title: Gazebo scenario results
svg.desc: One row per scenario and one panel per target with the true speed and the clearance to the obstacle over time, and the verdict of each check against the outcome the record predicts.
svg.text: Figure 1 Gazebo scenarios on each target: true speed and footprint clearance to the obstacle over sim time
Synthetic, no evidence credit. Solid: true speed (0 at the centre line, ±0.3 m/s at the edges); amber: clearance; dashed red: contact; dashed grey: fault
Under each panel, one chip per check, coloured by what the simulation shows (green holds, red violated, grey not exercised); a dark border marks an outcome the record does not predict
GZ-01 A low carton, 0.15 m tall, ahead of the robot driving at navigation speed through the collision monitor
GZ-02 A tall box, 0.60 m, in the same place: the positive control
GZ-03 The LiDAR stops publishing while the robot drives on an open floor
GZ-04 The undock reverse, 0.7 m at 0.10 m/s on the direct path, with a person 0.5 m behind the robot
GZ-05 The same reverse through the collision monitor
GZ-06 GZ-02 with the simulated LiDAR's minimum range at the RPLIDAR S3 datasheet value, 0.05 m, in place of upstream's 0.40 m: the control for the second finding
